responsibility: This implementation module adapts the generic RTExceptions runtime block to the language-level M2Exceptions enumeration. It initializes the current exception block for the module, reports the current exception number as an M2Exceptions value, tests whether the current coroutine/program is in exception state, and raises exException through RTExceptions when M2Exception is queried outside exceptional execution, making it the language-facing exception query layer rather than the low-level handler engine.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the M2EXCEPTION pair: it maps the public enumeration queries onto RTExceptions by reading the current exception block, raising exException when needed, and initializing the block in BEGIN code. Unlike gcc/m2/gm2-libs/M2EXCEPTION.def, it provides the executable bridge to the low-level exception runtime.
